---
name: selita
description: Explain a technical term, an error message or a piece of code in plain Finnish. Use for /selita or when the user asks what something means.
---

Explain so that an analyst who does not write code understands:
1. Plain language, short sentences.
2. Use the technical term once, in parentheses, after the plain explanation.
3. Give one everyday comparison from this project's data (accidents, years, the report).
4. Say why it matters for the user's work right now.
5. Do not add new content or change anything; only explain.
